title: Bio-Substrate PCB Research
subtitle: Academic Study on Mycelium-Based Circuit Substrates
description: Comprehensive scientific study & PDF documentation on substituting traditional FR-4 glass-epoxy printed circuit boards with organic fungal mycelium substrates.
longDescription: Traditional PCBs persist in landfills for centuries due to non-degradable epoxy resins. This research presents empirical lab results testing thermal stability and conductivity of organic mushroom mycelium composite boards.

attachments.title: Full Published Research Paper (PDF)
attachments.description: Complete research manuscript detailing dielectric constant, mechanical stress, and soil biodegradation.

title: Behind the Screen: E-Waste Short Reel
subtitle: 9:16 Vertical Reel & 16:9 Mini-Doc on Global Dumping Grounds
description: An engaging video advocacy campaign featuring short-form social reels and a short documentary exploring informal electronics breakdown yards.
longDescription: Informal scrap breakdown yards put workers and local waterways at extreme risk through open-air wire burning and acid leaching. This film project captures the human stories and advocates for safer automated recycling infrastructure.
